en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘There is none from the believing servants except in his heart would be two lights – a light of fear and a light of hope. If this was to be weighed, it would not increase upon this, and if this one was to be weighed, it would not increase upon this one (i.e. both being equal)’.
en.sarwar: 13. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain individuals of his people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“My father would say, ‘In the heart of every believing servant (of Allah) there are two lights. There is the light of fear and the light of hope. On being weighed no one of these lights weighs differently from the other.’”
